race.description: Dubbo Gold Cup Calcutta – 26 September Country Boosted Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: MISS KARIS (7) has a moderate winning strike rate but performed well last time at Mudgee, finishing third at the end of this trip when she did her best work late. Best figures measure up on the quick turnaround. Sure to run well. TAKE THE CHANCE (8) showed early speed from an outside draw last time and led for much of the way before fading to finish fifth at Narromine. Will push forward again and is expected to go close. MRS BULL (2) hasn't been far away lately, last time out finishing fourth over 1300m at Narromine. Yet to win this track and distance but has recorded four minor placings from five attempts. One of the main contenders. LEICA QUEEN (10) was responsible for a better run last start, beaten 1.4 lengths into fifth over 1400m at Gunnedah. Capable of featuring prominently.
